name: Protégé and WebProtégé
tier_reason: Market-reference ontology editor; target of Master Prompt 10.5 seed inversion 1 (partially validated)
owner: Stanford Center for Biomedical Informatics Research (BMIR)
latest_version: Desktop 5.6.9 stable; 6.0.0-alpha-1 pre-release; WebProtégé GitHub release v4.0.2 (master 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT)
release_cadence: Desktop: bug-fix releases every few months (2025-05 to 2026-03); 6.0 alpha is the first major in years; WebProtégé: no tagged release since 2020, active commits
license: BSD-2-Clause (Stanford) for both desktop and WebProtégé; transitive OWL API/HermiT/ELK/Pellet licences UNVERIFIED
redistribution_notes: BSD-2 permits embedding and redistribution with attribution. Bundled reasoners carry their own licences (believed LGPL/Apache/AGPL, unverified).
legal_review_reason: Reasoner and OWL API licences (possible LGPL/AGPL) if any are bundled into EOIP; not verified this session
community_vs_enterprise: Single open-source edition; no enterprise tier
resolution_note: Two products under one registry row: Protégé Desktop (Swing, OWL API) and WebProtégé (GWT, microservice rewrite). Seed hypothesis 'desktop-bound, single-user' holds for Desktop only; rejected product-wide.
action_reason: User-named, Tier A; seed inversion target
decision_summary: INTEGRATE for OWL interchange and ELK/HermiT sidecar reasoning; BUILD axiom-level semantic diff and review threads in BL-32; DEFER co-editing; REJECT WebProtégé stack as dependency

name: TopBraid EDG (TQ Data Foundation)
tier_reason: Leading enterprise ontology governance platform; seed inversion 2 target (partially validated; time-to-value claim unsupported)
owner: TopQuadrant, Inc. (Raleigh, NC); ownership structure not published
latest_version: EDG 9.3 (9.3.0-9.3.2); 9.2 completed RDF 1.2 reification and SHACL 1.2 features
version_date: UNVERIFIED (9.2 change log uploaded 2026-05; 9.3.0 change log 2026-08, from file paths)
release_cadence: About one minor release per quarter in 2026 (9.0, 9.1, 9.2, 9.3)
license: Proprietary commercial subscription; TopBraid SHACL API is Apache-2.0
redistribution_notes: No embedding or white-label rights evidenced without an OEM agreement. Open-source TopBraid SHACL API is redistributable under Apache-2.0.
legal_review_reason: Proprietary product with unknown OEM terms; Apache-2.0 SHACL API reuse needs NOTICE handling
community_vs_enterprise: No community edition of EDG; SHACL API and some libraries open source
resolution_note: Documentation now branded TQ Data Foundation (launched Feb 2026); TopBraid Composer replaced by EDG Studio. No Graphwise/Semantic Web Company acquisition of TopQuadrant found; that merger concerns PoolParty.
action_reason: User-named, Tier A; seed inversion target
decision_summary: REUSE SHACL engine (TopBraid SHACL API or pySHACL); BUILD Git-backed governance workflow and semantic merge; REJECT 'heavy footprint' premise as unsupported; EXPERIMENT with visual editor

name: PoolParty (Graphwise Graph Modeling)
tier_reason: Leading SKOS taxonomy/thesaurus platform; corporate-status trap (Semantic Web Company + Ontotext merger into Graphwise)
owner: Graphwise (merger of Semantic Web Company and Ontotext, announced 2024-10-23)
latest_version: PoolParty 10.2 / Graph Modeling and Semantic Analytics 10.2
version_date: 2026-03/04 (blog 2026-03-19; release notes dated 2026-04-22; some pages carry 2025 typos)
release_cadence: 10.1 in 2026-01, 10.2 in 2026-03/04; earlier twice-yearly Release 1/2 scheme
redistribution_notes: No OEM or white-label terms found; stack includes third-party components (Elasticsearch, Keycloak, GraphDB) with their own licences, unverified.
legal_review_reason: Proprietary; bundled Elasticsearch and GraphDB edition licence classes unverified
community_vs_enterprise: Tiered server bundles (Advanced, Enterprise, Search, Semantic Integrator); no open-source edition found
resolution_note: Brand moving PoolParty -> Graph Modeling inside the Graphwise Platform (transition guide 2026-02-27); PoolParty name persists in 10.x. Cross-reference C02 ontotext-graphdb (same company).
decision_summary: BUILD thin SKOS profile with per-concept lifecycle and release/rollback; INTEGRATE SKOS-XL import/export; EXPERIMENT dictionary tagger and local-model taxonomy generation; REFERENCE for licensing/TCO

sources.title: Semantic Web Company and Ontotext merge to create Graphwise

name: metaphactory
tier_reason: Closest commercial analogue to an ontology + mapping + governed AI layer; quarterly releases; new SAP and Ontopic ties
members: metis (Semantic Modeling Assistant, Search & Discovery Agent)
owner: metaphacts GmbH (rebranded metaphactory 2026-09-23), a Digital Science company since 2023-01-23
license: Proprietary subscription (current, terms not public); a third-party page describes the old 4.1.0 community platform as LGPL 2.1 + Commons Clause
redistribution_notes: No OEM or white-label rights evidenced; deployment repos (Helm, compose) show no detected licence; historical Commons Clause note needs legal clarification.
legal_review_reason: Proprietary with historical Commons Clause code; LLM providers are external APIs (egress policy)
community_vs_enterprise: Historical community platform existed (version 4.x); current public source repo not found; current model commercial
resolution_note: Name now 'metaphactory' (company formerly metaphacts); Digital Science also acquired Ontopic 2026-03-25 (relation to Ontop OBDA not verified). 5.11 concurrent modeling and 5.9 DB ACL are beta/experimental.
decision_summary: BUILD proposal-preview-confirm AI modelling and ontology-validated NL queries; EXPERIMENT schema-drift governed release bundles; DEFER co-editing; REFERENCE for licensing
